description: Work-efficient exclusive prefix scan (Blelloch) with multi-block support via recursive block-sum propagation. Measures throughput in GB/s.

scaling_param.name: array_size
scaling_param.description: Number of float elements to scan

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block (half the elements processed per block)

non_scaling_params.name: iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations for averaging
